answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by forcing every identity to forge a stake bond before it may vote or earn. Names are free but bond capital is not: splitting one balance into a thousand fake agents costs the attacker the same total stake, and to gain influence they must lock more real value. Caught deception slashes the bond, so a saffron seller or a sable broker cannot buy trust cheaply; each extra identity burns capital, not just CPU.
